name: razorfen_downs
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 129 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

The plan is hand-written as of 2026-10-23 (spec handwritten: true): the census and the fixes are in ~/TortoiseBots-audit/PREP-RAZORFEN-DOWNS-2026-10-23.md. Critters 2110 Black Rat and 4076 Roach (flags_extra civilian, 1 and 8 hp) are out of every group; the rare Ragglesnout 7354 is fought with leg 3's pack (he stands on a Splinterbone Warrior at 2413.0 1025.9 37.9) and is kill_first (Heal 12039, Dominate Mind 7645); Rakameg's four Worshippers 62676 (13-17 yd from him, inside his 18 yd sight) are the boss row's first, not a pull.

Patrols are real and long (creature_movement): Glutton 8567 walks a 351 yd loop round the Spiral of Thorns room (~140 s) and is the boss of leg 1; four Splinterbone Skeleton/Frostweaver/Thorn Eater spawns patrol 211-467 yd loops through that room; two more patrol the Amnennar approach. A pull block with `patrol` is written where a patrol crosses it, so the agent's driver waits; the run leader's rows carry no patrol.

The plan row's lists need the group's patrol_aggro rule: the room the Glutton patrols cannot be cleared without him; the first live run should meet him deliberately (his 30 yd boss row takes the room's remaining trash).

Needs: Tuten'kash (7355) has no spawn row: the Gong (GO_GONG) summons him after two waves of spider adds (instance script DATA_GONG_WAVES 1 and 10, then the boss). The plan does not ring it; the boss is not a leg.
Needs: Belnistrasz idol-room ritual (GO_BELNISTRASZ_BRAZIER, GO_IDOL_*_FIRE) summons Plaguemaw the Rotting; escort quest, optional

Adds not in the spawn data: the Death's Head Necromancer 7337 casts Summon Skeletal Servant (12420) on spawn; the Skeletal Summoner 7342 summons a Shadowcaster (12258) every 15-20 s; Amnennar summons Frost Spectres (12642) at 66 % and 33 %. No plan row can name them.

Lady Falther'ess (14686, spawn 2351 at 2582.7 695.8 56.9) is game event 81 (Scourge Invasion boss activation), whose start and end are 0000-00-00: she is never spawned (same as Scorn in the Graveyard). Leg 0's last pull stands 19 yd from her spawn; nothing to do.
